Claim 1 (currently amended): (Currently Amended) A cell comprising: a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, wherein the cell does not express propanediol utilization enzymes.

Claim 3 (currently amended): (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the non-native compartment further comprises at least one targeted enzyme that is not involved in the production of propanediol.

Claim 8 (currently amended): (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the proteinaceous shell comprises a plurality of different BMC polypeptides derived from at least two distinct bacterial species.

Claim 28 (currently amended): (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 comprising a plurality of compartments, wherein at least one of the compartments is an engineered subcellular compartment involved in a metabolic pathway different from ethanolamine metabolism.
